path: Gemma4DecoderLayer.mlp is the Gemma3MLP class alias
GeluAndMul invokes gelu_tanh_and_mul on the two [M,21504] halves
fp8_scaled_mm consumes FP8 [M,21504], FP32 [M,1], FP8 [21504,5376], and FP32 [5376]

ownership_and_reuse.gate_up: The merged gate/up output has one consumer, GeluAndMul.
ownership_and_reuse.activated_bf16: The activated BF16 tensor has one consumer, down_proj; Fp8LinearMethod quantizes it immediately and no residual or observer reuses it.
ownership_and_reuse.down_projection: The unchanged RowParallelLinear consumer retains its bias, reduction, output dtype, and TP behavior. Candidate dispatch is restricted to TP=1.

exact_geometry.activation: GELU tanh approximation on gate in FP32, multiply by up in FP32, single round-to-nearest-even store to BF16
exact_geometry.scale_convention: per-token dequantization multiplier max(abs(BF16 activated row))/448; zero row emits scale 0 and FP8 zeros

execution.stream: Candidate uses at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream for the gate_up device, matching both pinned producers and the unchanged consumer.
execution.cuda_graph: Extension compilation is outside capture. The runner captures and replays both complete baseline and candidate down-projection components at M=32.
execution.fallback: M>32, non-BF16, non-2D, non-43008, non-CUDA, and TP>1 inputs retain the original GeluAndMul then Fp8LinearMethod path.

candidate.mechanism: Fuse only GeluAndMul's BF16 producer and the adjacent per-token dynamic-E4M3 quantizer. Preserve the exact single BF16 activation rounding in 43,008 bytes of per-CTA shared memory, then feed the FP8 activation and FP32 scale to unchanged fp8_scaled_mm.
candidate.semantics: Semantics-preserving for the pinned finite decode contract; model weights, gate/up projection, down projection, residuals, attention, FP8 convention, and output dtype are unchanged.

cpu_oracle.evidence_label: analytical pure-CPU execution of pinned finite arithmetic and representation; target CUDA execution remains required

target_runner.required_primary: M=32 real layer-0 down-projection fp8_scaled_mm with complete output consumption and baseline/candidate CUDA-graph replay
target_runner.immutable_input_rule: Before a future claim, materialize a single-tensor safetensors and manifest under this project. The runner rejects a shared-path component or a SHA/checkpoint/key mismatch.

physical_hypothesis.regime: launch-sensitive, underfilled-grid elementwise producer adjacent to an unchanged weight-dominated FP8 GEMM
physical_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace separate one-round BF16 GeluAndMul and two-pass dynamic-E4M3 quantization launches with one fused launch and a shared-memory BF16 handoff.

per_layer_m32.contractual_derivation: one 1,376,256-byte BF16 activation write plus one compulsory consumer read
per_layer_m32.source_level_derivation: the pinned small-batch quantizer reads the BF16 activation once for amax and again for conversion, in addition to the producer write
per_layer_m32.dram_byte_prediction: 0 to 4,128,768 fewer DRAM bytes; the 1.3125-MiB activated tensor fits in 50-MiB L2, so removed launch count and L2/global sectors are the stronger causal discriminators

exact_workload_projection_358_decode_ste.evidence_label: byte and launch counts are source-derived; launch latency sensitivity is inferred and must not be treated as a measured endpoint gain

physical_hypothesis.target_falsifier: Reject if any required row or graph arm is incomplete, candidate-path proof is absent, finite numerical tolerances fail, the candidate does not remove exactly one producer launch, or the M=32 candidate component median is not below its contemporaneous stock control.

closed_mechanisms.mechanism: round GELU to BF16 before multiplying by the BF16 up half
closed_mechanisms.cause: Pinned FlashInfer multiplies FP32 GELU by FP32-converted up and rounds only the product. The two-round counterfactual changes 27.46% of M=32 BF16 activation values and yields 0.801% dequantized relative-L2 error.

closed_mechanisms.mechanism: apply the candidate outside decode M<=32 or at TP>1
closed_mechanisms.cause: The project contract freezes decode c32 and TP=1; runtime adapter dispatches every other geometry to stock.
